title: Filtered chromatic splitting at generic primes

issues.location: Secs 3, 5, 8, 9, 10-full-frame (coefficient finiteness, support comparison, full-frame rows)
issues.description: This is a scope limit, not a defect found. Everything rests on Proposition constant-module (H^*(P_n;B_conn,G) is the exterior algebra on xi_1..xi_m). That proposition in turn depends on about 5000 lines of p-adic geometry: the support comparison on Z=(N_t^m)_ind, trace descent, joint completion, and almost-scalar faithful flatness. This audit checked how those inputs are used and their bookkeeping, not their internal proofs. They are dense and lean heavily on cited results (Fargues-Scholze, Anschuetz-Le Bras, Scholze primitive comparison, Pignon-Ywanne). No specific step was found to fail, but this part is unverified.
issues.evidence: Prop full:surviving-module: 'Hom_k(M_t^i,k) (x) R ~ A_G^{m^2-i} (x) R', which uses Prop full-frame-comparison and Prop full:joint-completion

coverage: Read all of: the introduction and main theorem; Sec 2, the filtration criterion (checked block bookkeeping, the K(t)-quotient induction, rational independence via L_{K(1)}, the dimension count and the 2^n piece count, and the height-3 example ordering); Sec 11 (descendability/exact-functor Tot, the Galois extension of constants, Lemma flat-functions, Lemma ordinary-residue cooperation computation, and the Thm height-bases argument: filtration of the sphere-cochain representatives, the permanent-cycle argument, E_2=E_infty, finite filtered linear algebra, and the BSSW rational input); Sec 10-constant-module (weight-vanishing lemma, where I checked the Delta-character bound |exponent|<=n-1<p-1, the crossing-root sign argument, det^{-t}*det*det^{t-1}=1, the Koszul top edge, the degree cancellation i=m^2-a verified algebraically, and the exterior Poincare-duality step). Also read Thm coefficient-finiteness and checked that its lexicographic induction order (n,n-t) is well-founded with no circular use. Read the stable-generator statement and the sphere-representative lemma (image-of-J range a^2<=(p-2)^2<2p(p-1)-2, and the theta argument). Did not verify the internal proofs of Secs 3, 5, 6, 8, 9 or 10-full-frame.
main_claim: For n>=1 and prime p>n+1, X=L_{n-1}L_{K(n)}S_p has an ordered 2^n-stage filtration whose cofibers are the classical chromatic-splitting pieces Sigma^{-d(I)}L_{n-max I}S (with L_{n-1}S first, mapping in via the localization unit). This is deduced from classes y_i in pi_{1-2i}L_{K(n)}S whose products give K(t)-local bases for all 1<=t<n at once.
